root_cause.text: Lack of bounds checking on scatterlist index (sg_idx) and remaining scatterlist entries (sg_remaining) in nvmet_tcp_build_pdu_iovec, allowing out-of-bounds access when a PDU length or offset exceeds the scatterlist count (sg_cnt).
root_cause.evidence: CVE description states that the function "could walk past cmd->req.sg when a PDU length or offset exceeds sg_cnt and then use bogus sg->length/offset values". The patch adds explicit guards: checking `!cmd->req.sg_cnt || cmd->sg_idx >= cmd->req.sg_cnt`, checking `!sg_remaining`, and checking `!sg->length || sg->length <= sg_offset` before using the scatterlist entries.
